'''Zunor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Cathar (location)/Legends|Cathar]] who served as a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] before she joined the radicalized [[Order of Revan]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Zunor was among the Revanite commanders who led the Revanite forces in defense of the [[Temple of Sacrifice]] during the [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Galactic War)|battle]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Zunor was [[Death/Legends|slain]] in the [[Massassi village]] by forces from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]]-[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Yavin Coalition]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Master Zunor appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'', a [[2014]] Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and is one of four named enemies that must be defeated by players in the mission "The Enemy Within."<ref name="TOR" />
